descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a motivated self-starter? Are you at your best when supporting others? We’re looking for someone like that to:
• Support the team by dealing on a daily basis with clients’ inquiries
• Provide support to the team for new fund projects
• Perform and support compliance and due diligence reviews
• Assist in review and document existing clients to best in class level
